name: Tech Semiconductors Co., Ltd.
summary: Tech Semiconductors Co., Ltd. is a Chinese enterprise that specializes in the development, manufacturing, and sale of power thyristors and modules within the nation. The company's comprehensive product lineup features various high-power semiconductor devices, such as high-power thyristors, diverse semiconductor modules, essential power semiconductor components, and power semiconductor heat sinks for thermal management. Founded in 1966, the firm was initially known as Hubei TECH Semiconductors Co., Ltd. before officially changing its name to Tech Semiconductors Co., Ltd. in 2014. Its operations are headquartered in Xiangyang, China.
